jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established "experts" to join an advisory committee, not an entry-level paid role — it seeks senior specialists on climate-justice securitisation and defender criminalisation, well beyond the candidate's early-career profile, and is effectively an advisory (likely unpaid/voluntary) capacity rather than a genuine paid vacancy. The human-rights/security subject is interesting, but the seniority mismatch is a hard blocker.

jobs.title: MS Senior Assessor
jobs.reason: Senior title requiring at least 4 years of industry experience plus qualification as a third-party ISO auditor and a technical engineering/quality background — none of which the candidate has, so multiple hard disqualifiers apply. The role is also entirely outside the candidate's research, law and geopolitical interest zones.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established experts to sit on an Advisory Committee, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks recognised expertise in criminalisation of defenders and regional advocacy, which is a senior/specialist appointment the candidate does not meet. It is also effectively a speculative expert-panel posting rather than a concrete paid vacancy, and the Spanish-language track implies working proficiency in Spanish the candidate lacks.

jobs.title: Programme Officer- Maternity Cover
jobs.reason: Location policy is London only, and this role is onsite in Gaza with no London or remote option, which is a hard filter. The disability-inclusion healthcare programme work also sits outside the candidate's core zones.

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member – Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established experts to sit on an advisory committee, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks people with substantial domain expertise and, given the regional focus (East Africa, Latin America, Southeast Asia) and Spanish-language advertisement, likely working Spanish. It is not a genuine paid vacancy the early-career candidate would fill, so it fails the eligibility gate despite the human-rights topic.

jobs.title: Exams and Assessment Administrator
jobs.reason: Genuinely entry-level administrative work at the candidate's own institution, and the essentials (administrative experience, communication, IT, methodical approach) are all comfortably met — a winnable application. However, it is a professional-services exams/assessment role outside all three interest zones, offering no research or policy content, which holds the score down despite the strong fit.
jobs.salary: £32,890–£36,052 pa (progression to £38,422) inclusive of London allowance

jobs.title: Postgraduate Student Support and Advice Manager
jobs.reason: The "Manager" title carries essential requirements the candidate does not meet — demonstrable experience of student support and casework management and providing academic/pastoral advice within Higher Education, which is a distinct professional track rather than an entry-level fit. It is student-services administration outside the candidate's research and policy interest zones, so even setting aside eligibility it would score low.
jobs.type: Part-time (21 hours/3 days per week, 3-year fixed term)
jobs.salary: £43,277–£51,714 pa (pro rata), rising to £55,497 inclusive of London allowance

jobs.title: Graduate Programmes Coordinator
jobs.reason: This is an entry-to-mid administrative role with no disqualifying essential the candidate fails — "strong previous administrative experience" and familiarity with UK university structures are asks the candidate partly meets via RA and Rectors' Conference project-admin work, though the lack of full-time HE-admin experience is a real soft obstacle. Higher-education programme administration is only adjacent to the candidate's research and policy interests, so interest pull is low; it is a realistic but not compelling application.
